title: Sunderland Faces AZ Alkmaar in Europa League
seoTitle: Sunderland Faces AZ Alkmaar in Europa League
subtitle: Sunderland's First European Match in 52 Years Against High-Flying AZ
excerpt: Sunderland hosts AZ Alkmaar in the 2026-27 Europa League league phase, marking their return to continental football after 52 years, as the Dutch side arrives in top.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
On the afternoon of September 16, the Stadium of Light will host a clash that brings together tradition and renewal. Sunderland returns to the Europa League after 52 years and faces AZ Alkmaar, who arrives in excellent form in the Eredivisie.

What Makes the Match Special for Sunderland

The English club sits in fifth place in the Premier League and views the European spot as "an important step," according to coach Régis Le Bris. Despite Habib Diarra's long-term injury absence, the team has maintained three wins and one draw in their last five games.

AZ Alkmaar's Current Form

AZ Alkmaar is in 13th place in the Europa League league phase but stands out for a run of five consecutive victories in official matches. This consistency gives the squad confidence to seek their first win on English soil.

Market Odds

Bookmakers list Sunderland as favorites, with a win at 1.57, a draw at 4.20, and an AZ victory at 5.50. For goals, over 2.5 is quoted at 1.67 and under 2.5 at 2.15. Both teams to score pays 1.75.

Absences and Injury List

In addition to Habib Diarra, Sunderland has Browne, Mundle, and Alese as confirmed absences. AZ Alkmaar will also be without Clasie, Zeefuik, Resink, Kasius, Dijkstra, and Verhulst, but their winning streak indicates the team has absorbed these losses well.

Match Expectations

With no direct history between the teams, the match is unpredictable. The home advantage favors Sunderland, who seek to celebrate their return to continental competition, while AZ Alkmaar aims to consolidate their start to the season with a positive result away from the Netherlands.

With information from NETVASCO, Goal.com, Olhar Digital.
